(P2) THE MIRROR-PARITY OF THE TWIST DATUM — the killer: solving X A = A^-1 X linearly over Z gives the full solution module X = [[-d, d-c],[c, d]], rank 2, generated by J = [[0,1],[-1,0]] (det +1) and L = [[-1,1],[0,1]] (det -1). Verified explicitly: J A J^-1 = A^-1 with det(J) = +1, AND K = J*B = [[1,0],[-1,-1]] satisfies K A K^-1 = A^-1 with det(K) = -1. Structure proof: the commutant solve X A = A X gives exactly {p*I + q*B} with B = A - I = [[1,1],[1,0]] (the Fibonacci matrix), B^2 = B + I (so B IS the golden fundamental unit phi under Z[B] ~ Z[phi]), det(B) = -1 = N(phi). Hence centralizer of A in GL2(Z) = {+/- B^n} with det(B^n) = (-1)^n, the conjugator set is the single coset J * centralizer = {+/- J B^n}, dets = (+1)*(-1)^n — BOTH signs occur. Exhaustive box search |entries| <= 12: 22 GL2(Z) conjugators found, det values {-1, +1}, every one verified equal to +/- J B^n. Since X conjugates A -> A^-1 iff it conjugates -A -> -A^-1, the same coset governs the twisted (-A) double: with both determinant signs available, the twisted double admits both orientation-preserving and orientation-reversing equivalences to its mirror partner — mirror-SELF-equivalent under either sign convention. (P3) TWO-SIDED CONTROL: for M = [[2,3],[1,2]] (tr 4, commutant unit 2+sqrt(3), norm +1: a^2 - 3c^2 = -1 is impossible mod 3, so its centralizer is ALL det +1), the identical instrument finds 10 conjugators in the same box with det profile = {-1} ONLY — single-signed. So the instrument both recovers a known positive (Z/5 torsion present in the twisted golden double; torsion deliberately absent in the plain double, confirmed absent) and demonstrably CAN exclude a determinant sign (the sqrt-3 control excludes +1); the golden both-signs result is therefore informative, not vacuous. (VERDICT vs B1168) The twist class is dimensionless (a torsion class / a Z/2 gluing datum) but it is NOT mirror-odd: the mirror fixes the twisted double's equivalence class. It therefore does not restrict to c = Gal(K/Q) generator as a mirror-odd carrier. The exact killer, in one line: N_{Q(sqrt5)/Q}(phi) = -1 — the golden object's own fundamental unit has norm -1, and that unit (as B = A - I) centralizes the monodromy, converting any det +1 conjugator into a det -1 one. Walls honored: this extends B462 (plain mirror-double = plain double) to the twisted case — even the homologically-marked coupling is mirror-inert; B131's sterility is refined: coupling DOES create a new datum (the Z/5-marked twist), but not a mirror-ODD one; consistent with B1174 (the hearing side is mirror-even). Named residue for any successor cell: the killer is unit-norm-specific — a coupling built over a field whose relevant unit has norm +1 (the P3 control pattern, e.g. sqrt-3 = the Eisenstein side's real quadratic neighbor) would have a single-signed conjugator coset and the Z/2 could survive there.

Because BOTH determinant signs occur in the coset, the conclusion is robust to either convention for how det(X) composes with the base-circle reversal in orienting the total space of the torus bundle — under either convention some conjugator realizes an orientation-reversing self-equivalence.

The box search (|entries| <= 12) is a confirmation of the coset structure, not the proof; the proof is the exact linear solve (rank-2 solution module) plus the exact centralizer computation (commutant = Z[B], units = +/- B^n).

The two-sided control built for the locality-law instrument uses a small synthetic toy DAG (20-20-20 nodes, fixed out-degree 5) to validate the STATISTICAL TEST's discriminating power, not to reproduce Omega's actual numbers -- it shows the Spearman-correlation instrument recovers a planted effect and stays null when locality is deliberately absent, at a scale independent of Omega's own size/degree distribution.

All work independently re-derived twice by fresh code (different closure implementation, different degree-preserving algorithm, different RNG streams/seeds) with results agreeing to 2-3 significant figures; no external verification was invoked (all checks are in-sandbox, per house discipline).
refutations: The core numerics reproduce cleanly under two independent, from-scratch re-implementations (own bitset transitive closure, own bisection for d(r), an independent CURVEBALL-trade null vs the cell's swap-MCMC null, and an independent locality/Spearman recomputation): z~49-59 under degree-preserving nulls, the ~81% L7->L10+L8->L10 localization share, and rho=-0.612/-0.619 all matched to within sampling noise. So the measured magnitudes are sound. The defect is in the CONTROL claimed for the primary deficit-magnitude statistic itself: the evidence text labels "null-A draw #0 vs the other 99" (and the analogous check on null-B) a "Two-sided BITE control ... PASS", but both instances are the SAME kind of test run twice -- a held-out draw from a null ensemble scored against the rest of that same null ensemble. That is a negative/exclusion-side self-consistency check on whether the null's own sampling variance is well-calibrated (does the instrument avoid firing when nothing is really there); it is not two-sided. There is no companion positive-recovery leg for this instrument: no synthetic DAG with a deliberately PLANTED, known-magnitude transitive-closure/reach deficit run through the identical degree-preserving-null z-score pipeline to show the pipeline correctly recovers a real, controlled effect at the expected magnitude. The one genuine two-sided control in the whole packet (positive: planted local wiring -> rho=-0.842, PASS; negative: random wiring, same degree sequence -> rho~0, PASS) was built for the SEPARATE class-locality/cone-segregation Spearman law-instrument (part 4), not for the reach-deficit z-score instrument that produces the headline "11-sigma ... deepens to z~49-59" figure that anchors the "SURVIVES degree-preserving nulls" clause of the verdict. So the claim mischaracterizes a one-sided (exclusion-only) sanity check, repeated across two null variants, as a "two-sided" control for its central statistic -- the required positive-recovery half of the two-sided design is simply absent for that instrument, even though the raw numbers independently reproduce.
